title: Shortest first
statementMd:
List titles and runtimes, shortest movie first.

Expected columns: `title`, `runtime_minutes`.

Tables: `movies`, `directors`, `reviews`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT title, runtime_minutes FROM movies ORDER BY runtime_minutes;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
